brain-size.title: Brain size, in cubic centimetres
brain-size.kidTitle: How big was the brain? (cubic centimetres)
brain-size.note: The earliest hominins had brains about the size of a chimpanzee's. Homo naledi kept a small brain until at least 236,000 years ago.

ww2-deaths.title: War dead, as counted by each country's own estimates
ww2-deaths.note: Figures are the estimates quoted in the source: Russian government figures for the Soviet Union, the People's Republic of China's figure, the Polish Institute of National Remembrance, the historian Rüdiger Overmans for German military dead, and the Japanese government. Holocaust victims are also counted within their countries. The war's total is estimated at 60 to 75 million.
